headline: Approved adding new voter registrations and removing voters from the checklist, both 3-0.
summary: The meeting covered voter registration applications and changes to the voter checklist. Applications for new and transferred registration were approved by majority vote, except where noted, and voters who moved, were no longer eligible, or were removed for other reasons were removed by a 3-0 vote.
decisions: Accepted applications for voter registration, adding them to the checklist, 3-0.
Removed voters who moved to another New Hampshire town or city, are no longer eligible, or were removed for other reasons, 3-0.
Approved new voter registration applications by majority vote, except where noted otherwise.
Approved applications to transfer voter registration to Derry from another city or town, by majority vote, except where noted otherwise.

decision_evidence.quote: Additions and Changes to the Checklist: The Supervisors of the Checklist considered applications for registration by voters. Motion to accept by Supervisor Strakalaitis. Seconded by Supervisor Dombroski. Motion passed 3-0.

Voters Removed: The Supervisors of the Checklist considered removals of voters now registered in another town or city ward in New Hampshire, no longer eligible to vote in Derry, or removed for other reasons indicated. Motion to remove by Supervisor Dombroski. Seconded by Supervisor Messina. Motion passed 3-0.

The following applications for registration as a voter were considered by the Supervisors of the Checklist. Except where noted otherwise, the applications were approved by a majority vote of the Supervisors (Registrars).

The following applications for registration as a voter were considered by the Supervisors of the Checklist. Except where noted otherwise, the applications were approved by a majority vote of the Supervisors (Registrars).
